name: greenwells-lpg-platform
description: GreenWells LPG Delivery Fleet Management System - MONOREPO
author: GreenWells Team
note: This is a monorepo orchestrator. Next.js is in main-frontend/, Django is in backend/

scripts.build:backend: cd backend && python manage.py check && echo Backend is ready for deployment
scripts.migrate:reset: cd backend && npm-run-all migrate:backup migrate:clean migrate migrate:sync
scripts.migrate:sync: cd backend && python manage.py migrate && python manage.py createsuperuser --noinput || echo Superuser creation skipped
scripts.test:frontend: cd main-frontend && npm run test || echo Frontend tests not configured
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && flake8 . || echo Backend linting not configured
scripts.clean:backend: cd backend && find . -type d -name __pycache__ -exec rm -r {} + 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.deploy:backend: cd backend && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput && echo Backend deployment ready
scripts.deploy:frontend: cd main-frontend && npm run build && echo Frontend deployment ready
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd main-frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.production: NODE_ENV=production npm run build && npm run start
